name: 3/4 Sit-Up
cues: Lie down on the floor and secure your feet.

name: Alternate Hammer Curl
cues: Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length.

name: Anti-Gravity Press
cues: Place a bar on the ground behind the head of an incline bench.

name: Alternating Cable Shoulder Press
cues: Move the cables to the bottom of the tower and select an appropriate weight.

name: Back Flyes - With Bands
cues: Run a band around a stationary post like that of a squat rack.

name: Advanced Kettlebell Windmill
cues: Clean and press a kettlebell overhead with one arm.

name: Ab Crunch Machine
cues: Select a light resistance and sit down on the ab machine placing your feet under the pads provided and grabbing the top handles.

name: Air Bike
cues: Lie flat on the floor with your lower back pressed to the ground.

name: Alternate Incline Dumbbell Curl
cues: Sit down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length.

name: Barbell Ab Rollout
cues: For this exercise you will need to get into a pushup position, but instead of having your hands of the floor, you will be grabbing on to an Olympic barbell (loaded with 5-10 lbs on each side) instead.

name: Bent Over Low-Pulley Side Lateral
cues: Select a weight and hold the handle of the low pulley with your right hand.

name: Band Hip Adductions
cues: Anchor a band around a solid post or other object.

name: Alternating Floor Press
cues: Lie on the floor with two kettlebells next to your shoulders.

name: Butterfly
cues: Sit on the machine with your back flat on the pad.

name: Alternate Heel Touchers
cues: Lie on the floor with the knees bent and the feet on the floor around 18-24 inches apart.

name: Alternating Deltoid Raise
cues: In a standing position, hold a pair of dumbbells at your side.

name: Barbell Ab Rollout - On Knees
cues: Hold an Olympic barbell loaded with 5-10lbs on each side and kneel on the floor.

name: Bosu Ball Cable Crunch With Side Bends
cues: Connect a standard handle to each arm of a cable machine, and position them in the most downward position.

name: Band Skull Crusher
cues: Secure a band to the base of a rack or the bench.

name: Alternating Hang Clean
cues: Place two kettlebells between your feet.

name: Calf Press
cues: Adjust the seat so that your legs are only slightly bent in the start position.

name: Bent-Knee Hip Raise
cues: Lay flat on the floor with your arms next to your sides.

name: Arnold Dumbbell Press
cues: Sit on an exercise bench with back support and hold two dumbbells in front of you at about upper chest level with your palms facing your body and your elbows bent.

name: Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip
cues: Lie back on a flat bench.

name: Cable Chest Press
cues: Adjust the weight to an appropriate amount and be seated, grasping the handles.

name: Bench Press - With Bands
cues: Using a flat bench secure a band under the leg of the bench that is nearest to your head.

name: Alternating Kettlebell Press
cues: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders.

name: Calf Press On The Leg Press Machine
cues: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance.

name: Body Tricep Press
cues: Position a bar in a rack at chest height.

name: Around The Worlds
cues: Lay down on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with the palms of the hands facing towards the ceiling.

name: Barbell Curl
cues: Stand up with your torso upright while holding a barbell at a shoulder-width grip.

name: Cable Deadlifts
cues: Move the cables to the bottom of the towers and select an appropriate weight.

name: Calf Raises - With Bands
cues: Grab an exercise band and stand on it with your toes making sure that the length of the band between the foot and the arms is the same for both sides.

name: Alternating Kettlebell Row
cues: Place two kettlebells in front of your feet.

name: Calf-Machine Shoulder Shrug
cues: Position yourself on the calf machine so that the shoulder pads are above your shoulders.

name: Body-Up
cues: Assume a plank position on the ground.

name: Bent Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Raise With Head On Bench
cues: Stand up straight while holding a dumbbell in each hand and with an incline bench in front of you.

name: Barbell Curls Lying Against An Incline
cues: Lie against an incline bench, with your arms holding a barbell and hanging down in a horizontal line.

name: Cable Hammer Curls - Rope Attachment
cues: Attach a rope attachment to a low pulley and stand facing the machine about 12 inches away from it.

name: Cross Over - With Bands
cues: Secure an exercise band around a stationary post.

name: Alternating Renegade Row
cues: Place two kettlebells on the floor about shoulder width apart.

name: Chair Squat
cues: To begin, first set the bar to a position that best matches your height.

name: Bodyweight Squat
cues: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.

name: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row
cues: With a dumbbell in each hand (palms facing your torso), bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward by bending at the waist; as you bend make sure to keep your back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor.

name: Barbell Deadlift
cues: Stand in front of a loaded barbell.

name: Cable Hip Adduction
cues: Stand in front of a low pulley facing forward with one leg next to the pulley and the other one away.

name: External Rotation with Band
cues: Choke the band around a post.

name: Bent Press
cues: Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder.

name: Decline Smith Press
cues: Place a decline bench underneath the Smith machine.

name: Bottoms Up
cues: Begin by lying on your back on the ground.

name: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row With Palms In
cues: With a dumbbell in each hand (palms facing each other), bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor.

name: Barbell Full Squat
cues: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes.

name: Cable Incline Pushdown
cues: Lie on incline an bench facing away from a high pulley machine that has a straight bar attachment on it.

name: Hip Extension with Bands
cues: Secure one end of the band to the lower portion of a post and attach the other to one ankle.

name: Bottoms-Up Clean From The Hang Position
cues: Initiate the exercise by standing upright with a kettlebell in one hand.

name: Dip Machine
cues: Sit securely in a dip machine, select the weight and firmly grasp the handles.

name: Butt Lift (Bridge)
cues: Lie flat on the floor on your back with the hands by your side and your knees bent.

name: Bent-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
cues: Place a dumbbell standing up on a flat bench.

name: Barbell Guillotine Bench Press
cues: Using a medium width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over your neck with your arms locked.

name: Cable Incline Triceps Extension
cues: Lie on incline an bench facing away from a high pulley machine that has a straight bar attachment on it.

name: Hip Flexion with Band
cues: Secure one end of the band to the lower portion of a post and attach the other to one ankle.

name: Double Kettlebell Alternating Hang Clean
cues: Place two kettlebells between your feet.

name: Hack Squat
cues: Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided.

name: Butt-Ups
cues: Begin a pushup position but with your elbows on the ground and resting on your forearms.

name: Calf Raise On A Dumbbell
cues: Hang on to a sturdy object for balance and stand on a dumbbell handle, preferably one with round plates so that it rolls as in this manner you have to work harder to stabilize yourself; thus increasing the effectiveness of the exercise.

name: Barbell Hack Squat
cues: Stand up straight while holding a barbell behind you at arms length and your feet at shoulder width.

name: Cable Internal Rotation
cues: Sit next to a low pulley sideways (with legs stretched in front of you or crossed) and grasp the single hand cable attachment with the arm nearest to the cable.

name: Internal Rotation with Band
cues: Choke the band around a post.

name: Double Kettlebell Jerk
cues: Hold a kettlebell by the handle in each hand.

name: Leg Extensions
cues: For this exercise you will need to use a leg extension machine.

name: Clock Push-Up
cues: Move into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your hands and toes.

name: Close-Grip Dumbbell Press
cues: Place a dumbbell standing up on a flat bench.

name: Barbell Incline Bench Press - Medium Grip
cues: Lie back on an incline bench.

name: Cable Iron Cross
cues: Begin by moving the pulleys to the high position, select the resistance to be used, and take a handle in each hand.

name: Lateral Raise - With Bands
cues: To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length.

name: Double Kettlebell Push Press
cues: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders.

name: Leverage Chest Press
cues: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up off of a Dumbbell
cues: Lie on the floor and place your hands on an upright dumbbell.

name: Concentration Curls
cues: Sit down on a flat bench with one dumbbell in front of you between your legs.

name: Barbell Incline Shoulder Raise
cues: Lie back on an Incline Bench.

name: Cable Judo Flip
cues: Connect a rope attachment to a tower, and move the cable to the lowest pulley position.

name: Shoulder Press - With Bands
cues: To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length.

name: Double Kettlebell Snatch
cues: Place two kettlebells behind your feet.

name: Leverage Deadlift
cues: Load the pins to an appropriate weight.

name: Cocoons
cues: Begin by lying on your back on the ground.

name: Cross Body Hammer Curl
cues: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand.

name: Barbell Lunge
cues: This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes.

name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension
cues: Lie on a flat bench and grasp the straight bar attachment of a low pulley with a narrow overhand grip.

name: Speed Band Overhead Triceps
cues: For this exercise anchor a band to the ground.

name: Double Kettlebell Windmill
cues: Place a kettlebell in front of your front foot and clean and press a kettlebell overhead with your opposite arm.

name: Leverage Decline Chest Press
cues: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height.

name: Cross-Body Crunch
cues: Lie flat on your back and bend your knees about 60 degrees.

name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and lie down with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs.

name: Barbell Rear Delt Row
cues: Stand up straight while holding a barbell using a wide (higher than shoulder width) and overhand (palms facing your body) grip.

name: Cable One Arm Tricep Extension
cues: With your right hand, grasp a single handle attached to the high-cable pulley using a supinated (underhand; palms facing up) grip.

name: Squats - With Bands
cues: To start out, make sure that the exercise band is at an even split between both the left and right side of the body.

name: Extended Range One-Arm Kettlebell Floor Press
cues: Lie on the floor and position a kettlebell for one arm to press.

name: Leverage High Row
cues: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat height so that you can just reach the handles above you.

name: Crunch - Hands Overhead
cues: Lie on the floor with your back flat and knees bent with around a 60-degree angle between the hamstrings and the calves.

name: Decline Dumbbell Flyes
cues: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and lie down with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs.

name: Barbell Rollout from Bench
cues: Place a loaded barbell on the ground, near the end of a bench.

name: Cable Preacher Curl
cues: Place a preacher bench about 2 feet in front of a pulley machine.

name: Upright Row - With Bands
cues: To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length.

name: Front Squats With Two Kettlebells
cues: Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders.

name: Leverage Incline Chest Press
cues: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height.

name: Crunch - Legs On Exercise Ball
cues: Lie flat on your back with your feet resting on an exercise ball and your knees bent at a 90 degree angle.

name: Decline Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cues: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and lie down with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs.

name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise
cues: Place a block about 12 inches in front of a flat bench.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
cues: Adjust the pulleys to the appropriate height and adjust the weight.

name: Kettlebell Arnold Press
cues: Clean a kettlebell to your shoulder.

name: Leverage Iso Row
cues: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat height so that the handles are at chest level.

name: Decline Crunch
cues: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and lie down.

name: Dumbbell Alternate Bicep Curl
cues: Stand (torso upright) with a dumbbell in each hand held at arms length.

name: Barbell Shoulder Press
cues: Sit on a bench with back support in a squat rack.

name: Cable Reverse Crunch
cues: Connect an ankle strap attachment to a low pulley cable and position a mat on the floor in front of it.

name: Kettlebell Dead Clean
cues: Place kettlebell between your feet.

name: Leverage Shoulder Press
cues: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height.

name: Decline Oblique Crunch
cues: Secure your legs at the end of the decline bench and slowly lay down on the bench.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Lie down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand resting on top of your thighs.

name: Barbell Shrug
cues: Stand up straight with your feet at shoulder width as you hold a barbell with both hands in front of you using a pronated grip (palms facing the thighs).
